claims: John Calipari is the head coach of the Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team.
John Calipari was officially hired on April 10, 2024, to lead the Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball program.
John Calipari previously served as head coach at Kentucky.
Kelsi Musick was hired on March 21, 2025, as the 10th head coach of the Arkansas Razorbacks women's basketball program.
